[FACT] User has been waking up at 7:30 am.

[PREFERENCE] User is looking for healthy breakfast ideas that can be prepared in under 30 minutes.  
[EVENT] User is planning to try out some new recipes this week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided 7 healthy breakfast ideas that can be prepared in under 30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 1: Avocado Toast (15 minutes) - Toast whole-grain bread, mash 1/2 avocado, and spread on top; add a sliced egg, salt, and pepper to taste; optional: sprinkle with red pepper flakes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 2: Greek Yogurt Parfait (10 minutes) - Layer Greek yogurt, fresh berries, granola, and a sprinkle of chia seeds; optional: add a drizzle of honey or maple syrup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 3: Smoothie (5 minutes) - Blend together favorite fruits (e.g., banana, berries, mango), Greek yogurt, and milk or protein powder; optional: add spinach or kale.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 4: Overnight Oats (prep time: 5 minutes, cook time: 10 minutes) - Mix rolled oats, milk, and choice of nuts, seeds, or fruit in a jar or container; refrigerate overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 5: Peanut Butter Banana Toast (10 minutes) - Toast whole-grain bread, spread with peanut butter, and top with sliced banana; optional: add a sprinkle of cinnamon or honey.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 6: Breakfast Burrito (15 minutes) - Scramble eggs, add black beans, cheese, and choice of veggies (e.g., bell peppers, onions, mushrooms); wrap in a whole-grain tortilla.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 7: Muesli with Milk (5 minutes) - Mix together store-bought or homemade muesli with milk or yogurt; add fresh fruit or nuts.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the sound of the smoothie option.  
[EVENT] User is planning to try out a new smoothie recipe this weekend.
